title: Auto Transmission Overhauling
short: Comprehensive transmission overhauling services to keep your vehicle’s transmission running smoothly and efficiently.
intro: At Hot Pistonz Garage, we specialize in comprehensive auto transmission overhauling services to ensure your vehicle’s transmission system operates smoothly and efficiently. Our experienced technicians are equipped to handle all types of transmissions, providing high-quality repairs and maintenance to extend the life of your vehicle.
sectionsTitle: Our Auto Transmission Overhauling Services Include:

sections.title: Diagnostic Services
items: Transmission Inspection
Thorough inspection of your transmission to identify any issues or potential problems.
Diagnostic Testing
Use of advanced diagnostic tools to pinpoint specific transmission problems.

sections.title: Transmission Repair and Rebuild
items: Complete Overhaul
Disassembling the transmission to clean, inspect, and replace worn or damaged components.
Clutch and Band Adjustment
Adjusting or replacing clutches and bands to ensure proper shifting and performance.
Valve Body Repair
Inspecting and repairing the valve body to ensure smooth and accurate gear shifts.
Torque Converter Replacement
Replacing faulty torque converters to prevent slipping and overheating.

sections.title: Fluid Services
items: Transmission Fluid Change
Draining old fluid and refilling with high-quality transmission fluid to ensure optimal performance.
Transmission Fluid Flush
Complete flush of the transmission system to remove contaminants and old fluid, followed by a refill with fresh fluid.

Replacing faulty solenoids to improve shifting and performance.

problems.title: Common Transmission Problems We Address:
items: Slipping Gears
When your transmission slips out of gear or has trouble staying in gear, it can indicate a serious problem.
Delayed Shifting
If your vehicle experiences delays when shifting gears, it may be due to worn components or low fluid levels.
Grinding or Shaking
Unusual noises or vibrations during gear changes can signal transmission issues that need immediate attention.
Fluid Leaks
Transmission fluid leaks can lead to low fluid levels, causing overheating and damage to the transmission.
Warning Lights
If the transmission warning light on your dashboard is illuminated, it’s crucial to have your vehicle inspected as soon as possible.
